text.en: Claude is row 57 of the BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual table in the LLM area.
text.zh: Claude 是 BenchCouncil AI100（2022-2023）年度表第 57 行，所属领域为“大语言模型”。

text.en: The annual table leaves the publication field blank for Claude.
text.zh: 年度表中 Claude 的论文标题字段为空。

text.en: The Main Contributors field is blank.
Claude launched as a conversational assistant and API for tasks including summarization, search, writing, coding and question answering.
text.zh: Claude 以对话助手和 API 形式推出，覆盖摘要、检索、写作、编程和问答等任务。

text.en: Constitutional AI uses written principles and AI feedback to train a less harmful assistant with less direct human labeling of harmful outputs.
text.zh: 宪法式 AI 使用书面原则与 AI 反馈训练更少产生有害输出的助手，并减少对有害输出的直接人工标注。
